Reaction tallies on the OpenAssistant messages

Source: R/data.R
oasst_reactions.Rd

The reactions OASST2 records on the messages in oasst_messages, in long form: 2,469 rows over 1,294 of the messages, one per message and name, with the number of people who used it.

Usage

oasst_reactions

Format

A tibble with 2,469 rows and 3 columns:

message_id

The message, as in oasst_messages.

reaction

The name OASST2 records.

n

How many times it was used on the message, an integer.

Source

As oasst_messages: the emojis field of the same OASST2 file, Apache License 2.0, processed by data-raw/oasst.R.

Details

The names are OASST2's own, and they are realistically messy. "+1" (2,323 uses), "-1" (802) and "red_flag" (48) are reactions, the first two under GitHub's names. "_skip_reply" (1,365), "_skip_labeling" (857) and "_skip_ranking" (396) are not: they are the interface's skip actions, stored beside the reactions, and kept here because a real tally holds such things and an analysis has to decide what to do with them. emoji_from_counts() refuses a name it cannot resolve, by name, rather than counting it as nothing.

See also

emoji_from_counts(), which turns a tally into text the other verbs read.

Examples

head(oasst_reactions)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 3
#>   message_id                           reaction     n
#>   <chr>                                <chr>    <int>
#> 1 c5d1ac81-3370-44f6-bed6-ed02a016bb72 -1           1
#> 2 d121645a-6d6e-488e-bc4a-6208f93109c7 +1           1
#> 3 d121645a-6d6e-488e-bc4a-6208f93109c7 -1           1
#> 4 e7aa0bcf-82af-4589-b903-4af455b058bf -1           1
#> 5 960f1b99-9433-41c0-abf1-a2331a4773ed +1           1
#> 6 960f1b99-9433-41c0-abf1-a2331a4773ed -1           9
# the reactions alone, as text every verb can read
votes <- oasst_reactions[oasst_reactions$reaction %in% c("+1", "-1"), ]
emoji_frequency(emoji_from_counts(votes, reaction, n, id = message_id), text)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 5
#>   emoji name        shortcode group             n
#>   <chr> <chr>       <chr>     <chr>         <int>
#> 1 👍    thumbs up   +1        People & Body  2323
#> 2 👎    thumbs down -1        People & Body   802
